name: io.github.openITCOCKPIT/mcp-server
title: openITCOCKPIT
description: openITCOCKPIT monitoring: host and service state, history, downtimes, acknowledgements, patches

environmentVariables.name: OITC_APIKEY
environmentVariables.description: API key of a dedicated, least-privilege openITCOCKPIT user. This server presents it to openITCOCKPIT; it is never handed to a client.

environmentVariables.name: OITC_BASEURL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the openITCOCKPIT instance, e.g. https://openitcockpit.example.org - without a path.

environmentVariables.name: OITC_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode. The image defaults to 'http', which additionally requires MCP_AUTH_TOKEN and a published port; a client that runs this container itself wants 'stdio'.

environmentVariables.name: OITC_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Register the 15 tools that change the monitoring configuration. Off by default: they are not even registered unless this is 'true'.

environmentVariables.name: OITC_VERIFY_TLS
environmentVariables.description: Verify the openITCOCKPIT TLS certificate. On by default; for a self-signed instance set OITC_CA_BUNDLE rather than turning this off.
